meal.title: Plan the database schema for the grocery app
meal.objective: Outline that the next lesson will create MySQL tables for the app

voice.script: What tables does a grocery store need? Imagine the app as a library; the books are data stored in tables. Which tables will store our products, orders, and customers? First, identify the core entities: products, customers, orders. Now we’ll outline the main tables you’ll create in MySQL. Each table gets a primary key and relevant columns. That blueprint becomes the database schema for the next lesson. Your next step: List three tables you would create for the grocery app and their key columns.
